body:
Repurposing this issue for this week's meeting.

Agenda
- Attendees: Luke W, Joey, Anne, Kagami, Rakesh, Andrew, Luke, Lea

New topics
- https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8189 (Joey)
- https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3238 (Luke)
- https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/11345 https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/11255
- https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10548 (Joey)
- https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/pull/1503 (Luke)
- https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11452 (Lea)

Action Items (continued)
- Someone should create a new document as this one is getting long and slows down browsers
- Editors (and optionally Keith) should try to review interestfor. 

Minutes

3a: Joey presented. Luke said ship it. Anne will ask for feedback from WebKit folks.
3b: Luke: presented. Edgar will review from Mozilla. 
3c:  Joey presented. Non-composed for dispatching seems fine to people on the call. Unclear what Olli thinks. Olli needs to explain why source should not be exactly like relatedTarget in a composed scenario (people might decide to dispatch it synthetically).
3d: Anne: Domenic needs to look at the conformance aspects. I don’t think they are quite right, but I’m not entirely sure what to suggest as the requirements are rather esoteric.
3e: Luke: presented. Anne: file issues and maybe check with Kagami.

[Some more discussion on `<select>` that’s not minuted.]
